summary.text: David Vaughan is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives who represents District 27, having assumed office on November 14, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner, and notes that the Republican primary for his seat was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Vaughan was born in Greenville, South Carolina, and lives in Simpsonville, South Carolina; he earned a B.S. from the University of South Carolina in 1987.
His career experience, according to Ballotpedia, includes owning BrightStar Care Greenville/Spartanburg, GAS Ammo, and Space Group, LLC.
Vaughan succeeded Garry Smith in the seat and is assigned to the Education and Public Works Committee and the Operations and Management Committee in the 2025-2026 session.
